card.name: Words after adjectives like more, simple, basic
card.fires_on: The noun or preposition right after a degree or manner adjective, such as "more detail", "simple terms", "excellent demonstration of", "effective at". It appears mostly in general explanatory web prose.

modes.description: A small word such as "of" or "at" following an adjective or noun that describes quality or skill.
